October Key Highlights Wins & Watchouts

  • ✓
    Efficiency Inflection: Leads +21.8% on +7.8% Spend Growth

    Blended CPL dropped from $32.10 to $28.40 (-11.5% MoM) as high-intent non-brand search campaigns and organic comparison pages drove disproportionate MQL volume.

  • ✓
    Lifecycle & Interactive Demo Flows Lifted Conv. Rate (+24 bps)

    Rolling out behavioral email triggers and a shortened two-step form boosted Email conversion to 5.50% (+34.0% leads MoM) and lifted overall site CVR to 3.80%.

  • ✓
    SEO Pillar Content Delivered Lowest Acquisition Cost ($9.25 CPL)

    14 bottom-of-funnel solution guides published in Q3 reached top-3 SERP positions in October, adding 6,900 incremental visits and 242 net-new MQLs.

  • !
    Creative Fatigue in Paid Social ($59.43 CPL) & Partner Bounce Rate

    LinkedIn carousel CTR softened in weeks 3–4 (frequency > 4.2x), while Partner co-marketing traffic converted at 2.14% due to generic homepage routing.

November Action Plan & Recommendations Prioritized by Projected Lead Impact

  • 1
    Reallocate $10,000 from Underperforming Social Sets to Paid Search +290 Leads Est.

    Shift budget from high-frequency LinkedIn awareness ad sets into exact-match competitor & category search terms currently capped by daily impression share (68% IS).

  • 2
    Launch Co-Branded Partner Landing Pages with 2-Step Form +140 Leads Est.

    Replace homepage links on partner referrals with dedicated co-branded landing pages featuring social proof and the fast-convert form to lift Referral CVR from 2.14% toward 3.2%.

  • 3
    Rotate Customer Proof Video Ads on LinkedIn & Meta Retargeting -15% Social CPL

    Introduce 30-second customer ROI testimonial cuts and cap cold audience frequency at 3.0x/week to reverse ad fatigue and bring Paid Social CPL below $50.

  • 4
    Expand Behavioral Email Triggers to High-Intent Pricing Visitors +110 Leads Est.

    Deploy automated 24-hour follow-up sequences with vertical case studies for known contacts viewing pricing or integration docs without booking a demo.
